# T-6: Format review metrics output

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Render the metrics review report in text, JSON, and CSV formats with stable missing-data representation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Text output contains the required report sections
- JSON output is parseable and uses null plus status fields for unknown values
- CSV output has stable headers and status columns
- Search results are included only when `--search` is provided

## Implementation Notes
Keep formatting separate from scanning and aggregation. Reuse simple table/CSV conventions already present in metrics token where they fit.

## Test Strategy
Snapshot-style output tests for text and CSV plus structural JSON assertions.
